integrity_id.description: Stable unique identity for this integrity record

covered_through_sequence.description: journal_sequence this snapshot covers — all entries up to and including this sequence

constitutional_hash.description: Hash of all active constitutional facts at this snapshot point — represents current reality, not history

active_fact_ids.description: The fact_ids that compose constitutional reality at this snapshot — enables verification without replaying full history

prior_event_hash.description: Last event hash before this integrity snapshot — anchors snapshot in the event chain

event_chain_valid.description: Whether the event chain from genesis to this point has been verified

observation_count_since_last.description: Number of JournalObservations since prior integrity record

fact_count_since_last.description: Number of JournalFacts since prior integrity record

governance_count_since_last.description: Number of JournalGovernanceRecords since prior integrity record

molecule_count_active.description: Total molecules in non-terminal states at snapshot time

molecule_count_total.description: Total molecules ever created at snapshot time

generated_by.description: Governance authority that produced this snapshot — snapshots are governance facts not infrastructure artifacts

generated_by_trust_score.description: Snapshot of generator trust at time of record

gcpc_at_snapshot.description: Governance Cost Per Contribution at snapshot time — constitutional health metric

ecpc_at_snapshot.description: Evidence Cost Per Contribution at snapshot time — constitutional health metric

vrpc_at_snapshot.description: Value Returned Per Contribution at snapshot time — constitutional health metric

constitution_version.description: Constitution version operative at snapshot time

integrity_hash.description: Hash of this integrity record — self-verifying
